title: 第1200章 渡劫不忘装第1199章 让路人震撼的渡劫
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 劫云从中间向外扩散，汇聚的速度比一般情况下要快了一倍不止。
好消息的是，至少汇聚完成的劫云，规模和敖霞的劫云不相上下。
比郑常拉到理论最满，对域外天魔级别雷劫的程度要稍差一点。
还好，没有达到自己的程度，至少不是最大程度要死弄他，郑常悬着的心放下了一半。
待到雷劫落下，剩下的一半心，也才彻底放下了。
劫雷威力没有超标，不是什么大问题。
要是真出问题了，他也没辙了，唯一的办法怕是只有传送到风龙族地找敖霞，跟穆灵说说，看能不能拉她来救场了。
只是身边有这师徒俩，自己传送可能不太方便。
就算有朝廷发行那种又贵又不好用的法器能解释一下自己传送的手段。
但伙伴还在渡劫，自己突然离席，实在是很难解释得清楚。
幸好暂时不用担心了。
该说不说，敖青本事如何不好评判，一手装逼法是炉火纯青
普通修士渡个劫，要么是在地上盘腿而坐，要么就是御空飞行在半空中，或者作出防御姿态。
像是敖霞渡劫的时候，就作出了防御姿态，在空中承受雷劫的。
而敖青这小子，偏不老老实实飞就飞，还要耍帅地盘旋，迎面撞向劈过来的劫雷。
看起来就像是主动和劫雷缠斗一样。
装！
实在是太装了！
自己明明当着他的面，和姜长老师徒俩说不要留影的了。
这小子怎么还这么装呢？
还想自己录下来敖青被劫雷劈得哭爹喊娘的画面呢，看来是劈不到了。
果然有外人在，效果比留影都好。
这小子不是不想别人看他渡劫，是不想熟人看他渡劫啊，装逼给熟人看哪有装逼给陌生人看爽啊。
郑常无奈笑了笑，真是白白担心这小子了。
“当真是好风采，游刃有余啊。”
林珃忍不住小声道。
敖青的装逼确实有效，已经收获一位小迷弟了。
但这雷劫才刚开始呢，有些逼，一装就要装到底，只要有一刻装不下去了，前面所有的装逼都会变成打脸的大嘴巴子。
郑常已经准备好记录下敖青的丢人瞬间了。
赵书画的、郑常的、敖霞的，最近敖青已经看过三次化神雷劫了。
content_en:
The calamity clouds spread outward from the center, and the gathering speed was more than twice as fast as normal.
The good news is that at least the scale of the completed tribulation cloud is comparable to Ao Xia's tribulation cloud.
Compared with Zheng Changla, who is at his most theoretical level, he is slightly less capable of dealing with extraterrestrial demon-level thunder tribulations.
Fortunately, it didn't reach his own level, at least it didn't mean to kill him to the maximum extent. Zheng Chang's heart was half relieved.
When the thunder tribulation fell, the remaining half of my heart was completely let go.
The power of the tribulation thunder is not excessive, so it is not a big problem.
If something really goes wrong, he has no choice. The only way is to teleport to the Wind Dragon Clan to find Ao Xia, talk to Mu Ling, and see if he can get her to come to the rescue.
It's just that with the master and apprentice around, it may not be convenient to teleport by yourself.
Even if there is an expensive and difficult-to-use magic weapon issued by the imperial court, it can explain the method of teleportation.
But his partner was still going through the tribulation, and it was really difficult to explain clearly that he suddenly left the table.
Fortunately, there is no need to worry for now.
It’s time to say it or not, it’s hard to judge Ao Qing’s ability, he is very good at showing off.
Ordinary monks would either sit cross-legged on the ground, fly in mid-air, or adopt a defensive posture to survive the tribulation.
For example, when Ao Xia was going through the tribulation, she took a defensive posture and withstood the thunder tribulation in the air.
But Ao Qing, this kid, didn't just fly and fly, but he also circled in a cool way and crashed head-on into the thunder that was coming.
It looked like he was taking the initiative to fight with Jie Lei.
Pack!
It’s so pretentious!
I clearly told Mr. Jiang and his disciples in front of him not to take any photos.
Why is this kid still pretending like this?
I also wanted to record the scene of Ao Qing crying for his father and mother after being struck by the thunderbolt, but it seemed that he couldn't do it.
Sure enough, with outsiders present, the effect is better than taking photos.
It's not that this kid doesn't want others to see him overcome the tribulation, but he doesn't want acquaintances to see him overcome the tribulation. How can he feel good about showing off to acquaintances rather than showing off to strangers?
Zheng Chang smiled helplessly, worrying about this kid was really in vain.
"You really have a good style, you are so at ease."
Lin He couldn't help but whispered.
Ao Qing's pretense is indeed effective, and he has already gained a little fan.
But this thunder tribulation has just begun. Some people are so cool that they have to pretend to the end. As long as they can no longer pretend for a moment, all the previous pretentiousness will turn into a slap in the face.
Zheng Chang was ready to record Ao Qing's embarrassing moment.
…
Zhao Shuhua's, Zheng Chang's, Ao Xia's, Ao Qing has seen the God Transformation Thunder Tribulation three times recently.
title_en: Chapter 1200: Pretend to survive the tribulation Chapter 1199: Survive the tribulation that shocked passers-by
